name: pam_ussh
detailed_description: PAM module for Uber's SSH certificate protocol. Enables SSH authentication using short-lived certificates instead of keys, improving key security and audit trails.

parameters.ca_key: SSH CA public key file path

notes:
Enterprise SSH access control. Requires SSH CA infrastructure setup.
